##: Native Scoop packaging of Purrge: the PSGallery .nupkg is just a ZIP with the Python runtime; we unpack it into the app dir and expose a purrge shim, so nothing is written outside scoop (user data still lives in %PURRGE_HOME% or ~/.purrge).
description: AI 磁盘清理助手：空间不足时提醒，让 AI（Claude Code / Codex / WorkBuddy / DSH）判断哪些能清，你勾选确认后才删
notes: 需要 Python 3.8+ 在 PATH 上：scoop install python（或 python312）
配置与运行记录在 %PURRGE_HOME%（未设置时为 ~/.purrge），Scoop 不接管
后台空间告警与 AI 技能安装请运行：purrge install
